title: STEMI Versus NSTEMI: Clinical and Angiographic Differences
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess differences in the risk profile and in the coronary angiographic presentation between STEMI and NSTEMI. Moreover possible relationship between myocardial infarction presentation and renal function will be investigated.
study_population: Patients with acute myocardial infarction with or without ST segment elevation.
